data.description: Deep review (PR #524, hygiene H1/H3) flagged the poison-on-failure review-check verdict + covering-merged-PR filter as duplicated across review-coverage-lib.sh, fp-recovery-audit-sweep.sh, and verify-session-provenance.sh G3. The two NEW callers now share rc_review_check_verdict in lib/review-coverage-lib.sh. The verifier's embedded G3 copy (verify-session-provenance.sh ~line 602-633, plus the covering-PR filter ~line 484-537) is NOT yet consolidated because the G3 loop is tightly coupled to the script's GH_BUDGET/_api_call_count/cache state — a refactor needs careful, dedicated testing. A KEEP-IN-SYNC comment was added at the G3 site. Task: extract the covering-PR filter + verdict into the shared lib and have verify-session-provenance source it, with regression tests proving identical provenance verdicts before/after.
data.title: Consolidate verify-session-provenance G3 verdict onto shared rc_review_check_verdict
